data.content_ref: inline:The extracted_episodes.json (SRC_005) shares a mechanism with tests.json (SRC_001): both encode program evaluation through acceptance tests, where SRC_001 holds the test cases and SRC_005 holds the episode records of running those same tests across the poietics program's development. Refuted if the test identifiers or test outcomes appearing in SRC_005 cannot be matched to any test specification in SRC_001, indicating disjoint testing regimes.
